headline: Another quiet day; scores barely move
body: A second quiet day in a row with no scored events. Earlier stories continued to fade, moving a few endings by a hundredth of a point. Horizon Balance is -4.21. Enslaved God (41.72) and Conquerors (27.30) remain the top two endings.
movers_note: No ending moved by a tenth of a point; only fading earlier events, at 0.01 each.
